verdict.rationale: Kit documents OAuth 2.0 authentication for apps and an MCP integration that lets an AI client read/write a creator's account, but there is no evidence of scoped or least-privilege credential issuance (e.g., granular permission scopes, read-only vs write tokens) specifically for agent use. missing for 10: documented OAuth scopes/permission granularity, agent-specific credential limiting, any mention of least-privilege tokens.
